node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double linear remainder reduction
node.statement: With q=dr, a=dU, b=d^2s_2, and x=a-3, the h=7 cubic 2+2+2 core consists of the residual conic, one quadratic D_b in b, and two equations affine-linear in b after exact reduction modulo D_b. The fifth-equation slope is -x(x^2+q/6), separating the exceptional branches x=0 and q=-6x^2 from a generic three-variable elimination.
node.notes: Exact polynomial-remainder reduction only. No generic or exceptional branch is declared empty; all color, norm, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.
